headline: Learning reshapes the factorized 5-event graph so observation is increasingly converted into Active feeding and is recruited after unrewarded bouts.
definition: Each trial contributes two ordered semantic events: Other/Observe -> Unrewarded/Active/Passive bout -> next Other/Observe.
boundaries: The graph is factorized: action-state nodes only transition to bout outcomes, and bout outcomes only transition to the next action state; structurally impossible cells are intentionally blank.
The earlier 4-state joint-trial graph is deprecated for the main page and is no longer used in the displayed learning matrices.
Under the 5-event representation, transition-matrix rewrite magnitude does not significantly track ΔSRI within learners, so that earlier 4-state correlation is not used as a headline.
The SLM World Model advantage in the 5-event benchmark is driven mainly by prediction of the social sampling action rather than by a stronger bout-outcome classifier.
